review_comments.body: Can we add a test for ingress update case too ? Right now only egress is tested, so if ingress maps are missed in the close list tests still pass. Lets also add per pod maps and conntrack map to the ingress entry here so we catch if we close FDs of the entry we keep. Map key should be map name (aws_conntrack_map) and not the pin path. We can also check egressPgmInfo is empty in the stored context

Thanks for these changes

This test mocks the SDK, so we won't catch it if SDK changes how these FDs are opened or how maps are keyed. Can we add a kernel test in pkg/ebpf which loads real ingress and egress programs, runs recoverBPFState with updateEgressProbe=true and checks FD count does not increase ? Can you also share the FD count on a node with this fix ?
